caption:
Chill Flame profilingizda 🔥

Telegram NFT sovg‘asi Chill Flame #55224 ni ijaraga oling: 3 kundan 30 kungacha profilingizda ko‘rinib turadi. Kuniga 750 so‘m, 30 kunga −7%.

Chill Flame #55224: Flashlight belgisi — atigi 0,4%, Pacific Green fon 1,2%, Bowl of Hygeia modeli 3%.

Ijaraga olish: @ArendagaGiftBot — havola profilda.

#telegram #nft #telegramgifts #nftsovga #ijara #uzbekistan

concept.title: Suzani
concept.hook: Birinchi kadr — to‘q firuza mato ustida oltin chok bilan tikilgan suzani medalyoni, uning markazida ulkan oltin Chill Flame kosasi qizil olovi bilan; tepada "Telegram NFT sovg‘a ijarasi / Kuniga 750 so‘m"; 0,3 s da olov chaqnaydi, medalyon gullaydi va kosa sakraydi
concept.format: Tikilgan sahifalar (yangi): har bir qator ostiga oltin chok o‘zi tikiladi, har yangi qatorda medalyon gullari ochiladi — "Chill Flame / Flashlight belgisi — atigi 0,4%", "Profilingizda turadi / 3 kundan 30 kungacha"; keyin narx, bot va havola
concept.why: Qamrov har postda ~100–125 atrofida barqaror, like, saqlash va ulashish deyarli 0, obunachi 2; bitta post raqamlari shovqin. Shuning uchun doim amal qilgan qoidalar: gift — yulduz, katta va harakatda, palitra uning o‘z ranglaridan (Pacific Green fon → to‘q firuza, kosaning oltini urg‘u, olov qizili faqat uchqunlarda), 0-kadrda mahsulot va narx, kam so‘z, qulay sur’at. Hech qachon ko‘rsatilmagan gift (#55224).
concept.differs: Ko‘rinish (suzani mato, gullaydigan medalyon, kashta hoshiyalar — yangi), palitra (to‘q firuza + oltin + fil suyagi, olov qizili uchqunlarda), shrift (Bodoni Moda 900 / kursiv — 18d dan beri birinchi marta — + Manrope), harakat (oltin chok tikilishi, medalyon gullashi), musiqa (calm, A-minor, 64 bpm, seed 331), yangi silk.wav tovushi, gift (Chill Flame #55224 — birinchi marta)
